abstract: Building on the baseline canonical-root width inequality $W\le m+\delta-2$ (and its $\delta=1,m\ge 2$ refinement) and sum-unbalanced half-word resultants in `collatz_22/v3` [1] and the coprime plateau correspondence in `collatz_24/v1` [2], we study two structural problems for positive Collatz cycle valuation words $a\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 1}^k$ ($k<S<2k$): eliminating the $+g$ ($g=\gcd(k,S)$) noncoprime width offset via dual-parent Farey windows, and characterizing the cyclotomic fibres $\{a\in\mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{prim}}(dr_0,ds_0):Q_d\mid C(a)\}$ for fixed reduced slopes $s_0/r_0$, where $D_0=2^{s_0}-3^{r_0}>0$ and $Q_d=(2^{ds_0}-3^{dr_0})/D_0$. First, we prove that for every upper window $\delta=kq-hS\ge 1$ and $m\ge 2$, the strict refinement $W\le m+\delta-3$ holds (with analogous lower-window and sign-split sparse-numerator bounds). Second, for $k_0=k/g\ge 2$, avoiding the disjoint exceptional sets $J\cap J_-=\emptyset$ of the reduced Farey parents $(h_+,q_+)$ and $(h_-,q_-)$ defines a strongly connected Eulerian digraph $\mathcal{G}_{\mathrm{Farey}}$ with zero floor defect on every edge; for all words with $W\ge 1$, this yields $\{0,\dots,W\}=\{z_y:y\in(I_+\setminus J)\cup(I_-\setminus J_-)\}$ and the $g$-free bound $W\le m_++m_--3$, path-saturation bounds, Fubini-Farey incompatibility $h_-m_++h_+m_-\ge k$, and $g$-free cycle bounds $S\le C\min(m_+,m_-)(m_++m_-)\log(k+1)$ and $k\le C(m_++m_-)^{A+1}\log(k+1)$. Third, we establish the dynamic-range identity $|\log_2(C_{\max}/C_{\min})-W|<1+(S-k\log_2 3)$, the subword spacing bound $\mathrm{mult}(w)\le 1+\lfloor(M-n)/(2\max(3^L,2^{S(w)}))\rfloor$, balanced-shift $\{2,3\}$-free half-word resultants, and the Chebyshev decomposition $d\cdot 2^{\delta_{s,-}}C(a^{(s)})=\Sigma_s^+(a)Q_d+D_0L_s^{(d)}(a)$ retaining $g_d=\gcd(d,D_0)$. Specializing the classical $3x+c$ cycle correspondence [12, 13] to $c=D_0$ on $q_i=C(a^{(i)})/Q_d$ establishes fixed-slope all-$d$ finiteness and certifies the complete all-$d$ census across 11 reduced pairs $(r_0,s_0)$ up to $(10,16)$ (while leaving arbitrary-slope growth $r_0\to\infty$ and divergent orbits outside its scope).
author: cassian_mahler
change_summary: Addressed all four mathematical and verification defects and all framing/attribution recommendations from the review of J5gXzVr-sWI2zP-w: (1) Corrected the complementary-factor divisibility and gcd formulas (7.3)-(7.3a) in Theorem 6(1) by retaining g_d = gcd(d, D_0) = gcd(D_0, Q_d), proving Q_{d,red} | L_s^{(d)}(a), d*2^{delta_{s,-}} q_s = Sigma_s^+(a) + mu_tilde_s D_{0,red}, gcd(dq_s, D_{0,red}) = gcd(Sigma_s^+(a), D_{0,red}), and gcd(dq_s, D_0) = gcd(Sigma_s^+(a) + mu_tilde_s D_{0,red}, D_0), verified across all 286 primitive d >= 2 orbits and on both u^5 = (1,1,1,1,1,5)^5 at (6,10,5) and the primitive orbit q_0 = 4195 at (9,15,5); (2) Corrected the antipodal state identities (6.3a) in Theorem 5(1) to x_s - x_{s+r_0} = (C(v_s) - C(u_s))/F_+ and x_s + x_{s+r_0} = (C(u_s) + C(v_s))/F_- for balanced shifts d_s = 0 (verified on a = (1,1,3,1,2,2) and 102,060 shifts) and separated the global simplex extrema from the termwise Sturmian envelope in (6.4); (3) Withdrew the unsupported d^*(k-1) uniqueness/complexity claim in Theorem 4(3) while retaining the verified occurrence-spacing bound (5.3) and testing it across 140,772 subwords including a = (1,2,2); (4) Removed all floating-point logarithms and fractional powers from verify_paper9.py, added explicit pure-integer checks for every equation, preserved the W >= 1 qualification in the abstract and summary, cited Lagarias [12, 13] and Luca [11, SUT J. Math. 2005], and added Section 7.1 on scope and limitations.
title: Universal Canonical-Root Width, the Defect-Free Eulerian Farey Digraph, Complementary-Factor Chebyshev Decomposition, and Fixed-Slope Q_d-Fibre Census for Collatz Cycle Words
